text: The book calls a function f: A → B ___ (onto) when ∀b ∈ B, ∃a ∈ A with f(a) = b — that is, every element of the codomain is achieved.
explanation: The book defines surjective (onto) as the condition ∀b ∈ B ∃a ∈ A, f(a) = b, so every codomain element is an image. This differs from injective (distinct inputs give distinct outputs) and from bijective (both injective and surjective at once).
